title: Finding Dory
about: Dory sets off to find the family she lost as a child, with help from Marlin, Nemo and an octopus called Hank.
cue: Serve the snacks when Hank sneaks Dory through the Marine Life Institute.
faces: Open Ocean exhibit, Morro Bay, California

Marine Life InstituteFinding DoryForgetful fish. Unforgettable snacks.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersKelp forest seaweed crackersCrisp sesame nori, for a kelp forest that all looks the sameHow to make it6 nori sheets1 tbsp sesame oil1 tbsp sesame seeds1/4 tsp sea salt flakesBrush the nori lightly with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds and salt.Toast one at a time in a dry pan until crisp.Cut into strips with scissors.Hank's camouflage fruit platterWatermelon, kiwi, berries and grapes in colour blocks, so Hank blends inHow to make it2 cups watermelon cubes250g strawberries, hulled2 kiwi fruits, sliced125g blueberries500g green grapes200g vanilla yoghurtCut the watermelon, hull the strawberries and slice the kiwi fruit.Arrange the blueberries, green grapes and the cut fruit in colour blocks on a big platter so the fruit hides in patches.Serve with the yoghurt in a bowl for dipping.Shell trail cheddar crackersThe trail of shells that leads Dory homeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Cheddar cracker dough of cheese, butter and flour rolled thin, cut into shell shapes and baked at 180°C for 12 minutes until golden.Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with a pinch of salt and half a teaspoon of smoked paprika.Stir in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and bring together with 2 tbsp cold water.Chill 20 minutes, then roll out 3mm thick between baking paper.Cut into shell shapes with a small cutter and press lines in with a fork.Bake on a lined tray at 180°C for 12 minutes until golden.Cool before serving with a chive sour cream dip.MainsCalifornia chicken bowlsLime chilli chicken over rice with avocado, corn and black beansHow to make it800g chicken thighs3 limes1 red chilli, chopped1 tsp salt300g long grain rice2 avocados1 can corn kernels1 can black beans, drained1/2 cup salsaMix the chicken with lime juice, chilli and salt.Marinate the chicken.Grill the chicken until cooked through.Slice the chicken.Cook the rice.Build bowls of rice with chicken, sliced avocado, corn, black beans and a spoon of salsa.Ocean green pesto pasta with peasThe ocean Hank won't go back toHow to make itAs written, serves 4Orecchiette tossed with basil pesto, sweet peas, baby spinach and lemon, finished with parmesan and toasted nori crumbs for a taste of the sea.Cook 400g orecchiette in salted water, adding 2 cups frozen peas for the last 2 minutes.Toast 2 nori sheets over a flame until crisp and crumble them.Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water.Toss the pasta and peas with 190g basil pesto, 2 handfuls baby spinach, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy.Serve topped with the nori crumbs and more parmesan.SweetsDory blue jellyBlue jelly, whipped cream, orange slice. Just keep swimming.How to make it2 packets of blue jelly crystals1 L boiling and cold water, as the packet says300ml thickened cream2 orangesMake up the jelly following the packet, using the boiling and cold water as it says.Pour into glasses.Chill until set.Whip the cream.Top with cream and tuck a slice of orange on each for a little orange fish.DrinksBlue lemonade ice cream floatBlue lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on topHow to make it1 L cold lemonadeblue food colouring, a few drops500ml vanilla ice creamPour the lemonade into tall glasses and add a drop of blue colouring, stirring until ocean blue.Gently add a scoop of ice cream so it floats and foams.Serve straight away with a long spoon.
